interpretation.supported: regularized cell-specific personal shape adds forward predictive information beyond the focal marginal vertical state
interpretation.unsupported: within this post-outcome diagnostic, variance control does not recover positive forward predictive value for cell-specific personal shape

claim_boundary: Lambda is selected entirely within past self-history; held-out target outcomes cannot affect lambda.
This diagnostic is motivated by a known negative unregularized result and is not independent confirmation.
A supported result would rescue predictive shape information, not establish cognitive memory as its mechanism.
An unsupported result would strengthen the distinction between descriptive repeatability and positive forward predictive value, but would not prove zero biological spatial structure.
No lambda grid, target gate, support set, lag, weighting, bootstrap rule or interpretation threshold may change after outcome opening.
